sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Auditory, Tactile), Mnemonic Branch

system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu while you have a Bell Wire active.

Select one Bell Wire. It begins to ring out at such a high frequency that even eye sockets begin to bleed. All creatures in a 20-foot radius must make an Intelligence saving throw as their thoughts are thrown into disarray

Critical Success: The target takes no damage and suffers no additional effects.

Success: The target takes no damage but gain 1 rank of Dazzled.

Failure: The target takes 3d8 psychic damage and 1 rank of Dazzled.

Critical Failure: The target the target takes 5d8 psychic damage and are Blinded until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can have this jutsu’s effects originate from up to 3 Bell Wires. A creature can only be affected by one source of this jutsu at a time.
